completionRule: A page family is complete only when recipe, grammar, renderer, orchestration, QA, fixture PPTX, fixture preview, and acceptance deck evidence are all pass.

grammar.primaryStructure: One dominant KPI, compact supporting metric strip, period/source disclosure, and a restrained finance accent used only for data emphasis.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch financialKpiSnapshot is routed from layoutVariant financial-kpi-snapshot.
renderer.required: Dedicated KPI snapshot branch with visible hierarchy separate from chart grids and quarterly summaries.

grammar.primaryStructure: Two-by-two or three-chart grid with an attached commentary rail and a bottom insight bar that explains the data movement.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch chartGridWithCommentary is routed from layoutVariant chart-grid-with-commentary.
renderer.required: Chart grid branch with chart/commentary spatial binding instead of KPI-card reuse.

grammar.primaryStructure: Quarter label, reported metric block, variance explanation, management action, and guidance/source disclosure in a board-readable hierarchy.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch quarterlyResultsSummary is routed from layoutVariant quarterly-results-summary.
renderer.required: Results summary branch with period, variance, and guidance zones.

grammar.primaryStructure: Assumption, risk, trigger, owner/action, and guidance sensitivity shown as a management-control board.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch guidanceAndRiskBoard is routed from layoutVariant guidance-and-risk-board.
renderer.required: Guidance board branch with trigger/action columns or equivalent risk ownership structure.

grammar.primaryStructure: Inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes, and capital/proof notes connected by a visible left-to-right value flow.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch valueCreationProcessMapSlide is routed from layoutVariant value-creation-process-map.
renderer.required: Integrated-report value creation branch with capital/proof lanes.

grammar.primaryStructure: Two-axis matrix with stakeholder impact, business impact, priority zones, and positioned topics.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch materialityMatrixBoard is routed from layoutVariant materiality-matrix-board.
renderer.required: Materiality branch with explicit ESG/topic coordinate rendering.

grammar.primaryStructure: Evidence image, impact metric, initiative description, and caption/source note paired in an ESG proof spread.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch sustainabilityProofSpread is routed from layoutVariant sustainability-proof-spread.
renderer.required: Sustainability spread branch that forces image/caption/metric pairing.

grammar.primaryStructure: Editorial governance table with responsibility, cadence, evidence, decision, and a quiet source/disclosure footer.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch governanceTableEditorial is routed from layoutVariant governance-table-editorial.
renderer.required: Governance editorial table branch distinct from generic risk/control tables.

grammar.primaryStructure: Culture cover with soft geometry, people/company signal, sparse metadata, and warm but non-decorative stage composition.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch cultureCoverSoftGeometry is routed from layoutVariant culture-cover-with-soft-geometry.
renderer.required: Culture cover branch separate from generic manifesto and beauty/editorial covers.

grammar.primaryStructure: Large mission statement supported by behavior principles and proof examples, not a slogan-only page.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch missionStatementStage is routed from layoutVariant mission-statement-stage.
renderer.required: Mission stage branch with behavior proof gate.

grammar.primaryStructure: People evidence wall where every image has a role, scene, output, and captioned proof of behavior.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch peopleProofMosaic is routed from layoutVariant people-proof-mosaic.
renderer.required: People mosaic branch that enforces role/caption evidence per image.

grammar.primaryStructure: Four value cards combining principle, observable behavior, and proof example, with no title-only value cards.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch valuePrincipleCards is routed from layoutVariant value-principle-cards.
renderer.required: Principle card branch with required behavior/proof fields.

grammar.primaryStructure: Product, texture, and brand-world hierarchy with restrained premium palette and inspectable visual subject.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch beautyBrandEditorialCover is routed from layoutVariant beauty-brand-editorial-cover.
renderer.required: Beauty editorial cover branch distinct from general covers.

grammar.primaryStructure: Brand world, product promise, channel/member signal, and business proof shown on one slide.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch brandWorldBusinessProof is routed from layoutVariant brand-world-and-business-proof.
renderer.required: Brand/business proof branch that combines visual brand evidence with operating proof.

grammar.primaryStructure: Three-part or four-part consumer proof grid connecting scene, reason, repeat/purchase signal, and caption.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch consumerProofPhotoGrid is routed from layoutVariant consumer-proof-photo-grid.
renderer.required: Keep the branch and add fixture, preview, and fallback QA evidence.

grammar.primaryStructure: Hero product, texture/detail panels, claim, benefit, and evidence caption in a product-led story.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch productEvidenceStory is routed from layoutVariant product-evidence-story.
renderer.required: Product story branch distinct from consumer photo grid.

grammar.primaryStructure: Airy opening with abstract concept, generous whitespace, one proof object or metaphor, and industry-neutral restraint.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch airyConceptOpening is routed from layoutVariant airy-concept-opening.
renderer.required: Airy opening branch that does not inherit beauty-specific styling.

grammar.primaryStructure: One central object with surrounding forces, relationships, and an outcome layer; the slide must have one visible center.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch singleObjectConceptMapSlide is routed from layoutVariant single-object-concept-map.
renderer.required: Single-object concept map branch with explicit central object geometry.

grammar.primaryStructure: Executive claim, mixed evidence set, and decision implication tied together as a board-ready proof surface.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch executiveProofBoard is routed from layoutVariant executive-proof-board.
renderer.required: Executive proof board branch connecting evidence items to a decision.

grammar.primaryStructure: Final decision, next actions, contact or owner, and an industry-aware visual anchor; no empty thank-you-only ending.

renderer.current: Dedicated renderer branch premiumClosingAnchor is routed from layoutVariant premium-closing-anchor.
renderer.required: Premium closing branch that varies by industry and requires action/contact evidence.
